answer: One concrete Sybil defense is slashable staked identity. Each agent locks collateral in a vault to earn one grading seat; voting power equals stake, not headcount. Splitting a fixed budget across a hundred fakes buys no extra influence, and detected collusion slashes the culprit's vault. Reputation becomes a pearl worth protecting: honest agents compound it, attackers forfeit it. Auditors sharp as a falcon sample votes to expose rings. The attacker pays the full seized stake plus every future reward, so each extra fake identity raises the price, never the payoff.
